				let o = 1;
				if (prog < inEdge)  o = prog / inEdge;
				else if (prog > outEdge) o = 1 - (prog - outEdge) / (1 - outEdge);
				return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, o));
			}

			const particles = Array.from({ length: PARTICLE_COUNT }, makeParticle);

			let running = false;
			let last = performance.now();

			function frame(now) {
				let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
				last = now;
				if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp after tab was backgrounded

				// Ease parallax toward cursor.
				mx += (targetX - mx) * PARALLAX_EASE;
				my += (targetY - my) * PARALLAX_EASE;

				// Grid moves opposite to images.
				grid.style.transform = `translate(${mx * GRID_PARALLAX}px, ${my * GRID_PARALLAX}px)`;

				const hw = halfW(), hh = halfH();
				for (const p of particles) {
					p.z -= Z_SPEED * dt; // camera moves forward

					let expand = Z_FAR / p.z;
					let scale  = SCALE_K / p.z;
					let px     = -mx * PARALLAX * expand;
					let py     = -my * PARALLAX * expand;
					let tx     = p.ox * expand + px;
					let ty     = p.oy * expand + py;

					const m = p.size * scale;
					if (p.z <= Z_NEAR || Math.abs(tx) > hw + m || Math.abs(ty) > hh + m) {
						reset(p);
						expand = Z_FAR / p.z; scale  = SCALE_K / p.z;
						px     = -mx * PARALLAX * expand; py = -my * PARALLAX * expand;
						tx     = p.ox * expand + px;      ty = p.oy * expand + py;
					}

					p.el.style.transform = `translate(-50%,-50%) translate(${tx}px,${ty}px) scale(${scale})`;
					p.el.style.opacity   = (fade(p.z) * MAX_OPACITY).toFixed(3);
					const zi = (scale * 1000) | 0;
					if (zi !== p.zi) { p.el.style.zIndex = zi; p.zi = zi; }
				}

				if (running) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
			}

			function start() {
				if (running) return;
				running = true;
				last = performance.now(); // reset clock so dt doesn't jump after a pause
				requestAnimationFrame(frame);
			}
			function stop() { running = false; }

			const heroContent = root.querySelector('.hero-content');

			if (reduceMotion) {
				// Static, non-animated field for users who prefer reduced motion.
				particles.forEach(p => {
					reset(p, rand(0.4, 1.3));
					const expand = Z_FAR / p.z;
					const scale  = SCALE_K / p.z;
					p.el.style.transform = `translate(-50%,-50%) translate(${p.ox * expand}px,${p.oy * expand}px) scale(${scale})`;
					p.el.style.opacity   = (fade(p.z) * MAX_OPACITY).toFixed(3);
					p.el.style.zIndex    = String((scale * 1000) | 0);
				});
			} else {
				// Hero is sticky so it stays "intersecting" — drive the loop from scroll position.
				const onScrollHero = () => {
					const y = window.scrollY, vh = window.innerHeight;
					(y < vh * 0.98) ? start() : stop(); // pause once the VP panel covers it
					const progress = Math.min(1, y / vh); // 0 → 1 over one viewport scroll
					if (heroContent) {
						heroContent.style.opacity   = String(1 - progress * 0.9);
						heroContent.style.transform = `translateY(${-progress * 40}px)`;
					}
				};
				window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollHero, { passive: true });
				onScrollHero();
			}
		})();

		/* ════ VP stat marquee: duplicate tiles for seamless loop ═══════════ */
		(function () {
			const track = root.querySelector('.vp-track');
			if (!track) return;
			track.querySelectorAll('.stat-tile').forEach(card => {
				const clone = card.cloneNode(true);
				clone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
				track.appendChild(clone);
			});
		})();

		/* ════ VP eyebrow reveal: slide in + up when section enters view ════ */
		(function () {
			const inner = root.querySelector('.vp-inner');
			if (!inner) return;
			const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
			if (reduce || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
			inner.classList.add('pre-reveal');
			const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
				if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
					inner.classList.add('revealed');
					io.disconnect();
				}
			}, { threshold: 0.6, rootMargin: '0px 0px -20% 0px' });
			io.observe(inner);
		})();

		/* ════ VP headline + subhead: words fill from dim to full on scroll ═ */
		(function () {
			const h   = root.querySelector('.vp-headline');
			const sub = root.querySelector('.vp-subhead');
			if (!h) return;

			// Rebuild element's text as individual word <span>s; returns the spans.
			function makeWords(el) {
				const text = el.textContent.trim();
				el.textContent = '';
				return text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(w => {
					const s = document.createElement('span');
					s.className   = 'w';
					s.textContent = w;
					el.appendChild(s);
					el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '));
					return s;
				});
			}

			// Fill headline first, then flow straight into the subhead.
			const words = [...makeWords(h), ...(sub ? makeWords(sub) : [])];

			const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
			if (reduce) { words.forEach(s => (s.style.opacity = '1')); return; }

			const wrap = root.querySelector('.vp-pin-wrap');
			const N    = words.length;
			const SOFT = 3;   // words covered by the soft "cursor" front
			const DIM  = 0.1; // resting opacity before a word fills
			// No parallax fill on mobile — CSS unpins the section and shows text at full opacity.
			const mqDesktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 769px)');
			let ticking = false;

			function update() {
				ticking = false;
				if (!wrap || !mqDesktop.matches) return;
				// progress through the pinned range: 0 when section locks, 1 when text is full.
				const fill  = Math.max(1, wrap.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight);
				const p     = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -wrap.getBoundingClientRect().top / fill));
				const front = p * (N + SOFT);
				for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
					const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (front - i) / SOFT));
					words[i].style.opacity = (DIM + (1 - DIM) * v).toFixed(3);
				}
			}

			const onScrollVP = () => { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } };
			window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollVP, { passive: true });
			window.addEventListener('resize', onScrollVP);
			update();
		})();

		/* ════ Social Proof ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
		(function () {
			const spSection = root.querySelector('.sp-section');
			if (!spSection) return;

			/* ── Quote carousel ── */
			(function () {
				const carousel  = spSection.querySelector('.sp-quote-carousel');
				if (!carousel) return;
				const qSlides   = [...carousel.querySelectorAll('[data-slide-quote]')];
				const aSlides   = [...carousel.querySelectorAll('[data-slide-attr]')];
				const fill      = carousel.querySelector('.sp-progress-fill');
				const total     = qSlides.length;
				if (total === 0) return;

				let current = 0, locked = false;
				const OUT = 180, IN = 260;

				function goTo(index) {
					if (locked || index === current) return;
					locked = true;
					const outQ = qSlides[current], inQ = qSlides[index];
					const outA = aSlides[current], inA = aSlides[index];

					outQ.style.transition = 'opacity ' + OUT + 'ms ease-in'; outQ.style.opacity = '0';
					outA.style.transition = 'opacity ' + OUT + 'ms ease-in'; outA.style.opacity = '0';

					setTimeout(function () {
						outQ.classList.remove('active'); outQ.style.cssText = '';
						outA.classList.remove('active'); outA.style.cssText = '';
						inQ.style.opacity = '0'; inQ.classList.add('active');
						inA.style.opacity = '0'; inA.classList.add('active');
						requestAnimationFrame(function () { requestAnimationFrame(function () {
							inQ.style.transition = 'opacity ' + IN + 'ms ease-out'; inQ.style.opacity = '1';
							inA.style.transition = 'opacity ' + IN + 'ms ease-out'; inA.style.opacity = '1';
						}); });
						locked = false;
					}, OUT + 20);

					if (fill) fill.style.width = (((index + 1) / total) * 100) + '%';
					current = index;
				}

				const prevBtn = carousel.querySelector('.sp-arrow-prev');
				const nextBtn = carousel.querySelector('.sp-arrow-next');
				if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { goTo((current - 1 + total) % total); });
				if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { goTo((current + 1) % total); });

				carousel.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
					if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  { e.preventDefault(); goTo((current - 1 + total) % total); }
					if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); goTo((current + 1) % total); }
				});
			})();

			/* ── Scroll reveals (section header, cards, carousel) ── */
			(function () {
				const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
				const items  = spSection.querySelectorAll('.sp-reveal');
				if (reduce || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
					items.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('sp-is-visible'); });
					return;
				}
				const io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
					entries.forEach(function (e) {
						if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('sp-is-visible'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
					});
				}, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px', threshold: 0.12 });
				items.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
			})();
		})();

		/* ════ UVP Scroll Lock ════════════════════════════════════════════ */
		(function () {
			var uvpSection = root.querySelector('.hm-uvp');
			if (!uvpSection) return;

			var isMobile     = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)').matches;
			var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

			/* Reveal items */
			var reveals = uvpSection.querySelectorAll('.hm-uvp-reveal');
			if (reduceMotion || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
				reveals.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('hm-uvp-is-visible'); });
			} else {
				var revealIO = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
					entries.forEach(function (e) {
						if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('hm-uvp-is-visible'); revealIO.unobserve(e.target); }
					});
				}, { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px' });
				reveals.forEach(function (el) { revealIO.observe(el); });
			}

			/* Adaptive sticky stacking: pin each kicker directly below the previous
			   one using its real rendered height, so 1/2/3-line kickers never overlap
			   and no per-section height needs to be maintained by hand. Recomputed on
			   load, after webfonts settle, and on resize. Only while pinned (>992px);
			   below that the locks are static (CSS), so any inline top is cleared. */
			var headingLock = uvpSection.querySelector('.hm-lock-different');
			var kickerLocks = Array.prototype.slice.call(uvpSection.querySelectorAll('.hm-lock-kicker'));
			var stackMq     = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 993px)');
			var STACK_GAP   = 24;

			function layoutKickerStack() {
				if (!stackMq.matches) {
					kickerLocks.forEach(function (el) { el.style.top = ''; });
					return;
				}
				var base = 128;
				if (headingLock) {
					var ht = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(headingLock).top);
					if (!isNaN(ht)) { base = ht; }
					base += headingLock.offsetHeight;
				}
				var acc = base + STACK_GAP;
				kickerLocks.forEach(function (el) {
					el.style.top = Math.round(acc) + 'px';
					acc += el.offsetHeight + STACK_GAP;
				});
			}

			layoutKickerStack();
			window.addEventListener('resize', layoutKickerStack);
			if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
				document.fonts.ready.then(layoutKickerStack);
			}

			if (!isMobile) {
				/* Arrow swap + dark-mode toggle */
				var arrows = uvpSection.querySelectorAll('.hm-kicker-arrow');
				var sects  = uvpSection.querySelectorAll('.hm-uvp-section-right');

				function updateUVP() {
					var line   = window.innerHeight * 0.6;
					var active = -1;
					for (var i = 0; i < sects.length; i++) {
						if (sects[i].getBoundingClientRect().top <= line) active = i;
					}
					for (var j = 0; j < arrows.length; j++) {
						arrows[j].classList.toggle('hm-is-visible', j === active);
					}
					uvpSection.classList.toggle('is-dark', active === sects.length - 1);
				}
				window.addEventListener('scroll', updateUVP, { passive: true });
				window.addEventListener('resize', updateUVP);
				updateUVP();

				/* Fade locks as CTA banner scrolls into view */
				var allLocks  = Array.from(uvpSection.querySelectorAll('.hm-uvp-lock'));
				var ctaBanner = uvpSection.querySelector('.hm-cta-banner');
				var fadeRange = 120;

				function updateLockFade() {
					if (!ctaBanner) return;
					var mid    = window.innerHeight * 0.8;
					var ctaTop = ctaBanner.getBoundingClientRect().top;
					var t      = (ctaTop - mid) / fadeRange;
					var opacity = String(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, t)));
					allLocks.forEach(function (l) { l.style.opacity = opacity; });
				}
				window.addEventListener('scroll', updateLockFade, { passive: true });
				window.addEventListener('resize', updateLockFade);
				updateLockFade();
			}
		})();

		/* ════ Dot-grid canvas (UVP dark section background) ══════════════ */
		(function () {
			var canvas = root.querySelector('.hm-uvp-canvas');
			if (!canvas) return;
			var ctx   = canvas.getContext('2d');
			var dpr   = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
			var uvpEl = canvas.parentElement;

			function resize() {
				var w = uvpEl.offsetWidth;
				var h = uvpEl.offsetHeight;
				canvas.width  = w * dpr;
				canvas.height = h * dpr;
				canvas.style.width  = w + 'px';
				canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
			}
			resize();
			window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

			var CONFIG = {
				spacing: 32, dotR: 1.20, baseA: 0.04, peakA: 0.20, curve: 1.0,
				lights: [
					{ cx: 0.45, cy: 0.40, rx: 0.30, ry: 0.25, sx: 0.05, sy: 0.03, r: 320, brightness: 1.00 },
					{ cx: 0.65, cy: 0.60, rx: 0.22, ry: 0.30, sx: 0.05, sy: 0.08, r: 170, brightness: 0.70 },
					{ cx: 0.25, cy: 0.65, rx: 0.18, ry: 0.20, sx: 0.06, sy: 0.05, r: 200, brightness: 1.25 },
				],
			};
			var DOT_COLOR = '199, 187, 166'; // --hm-coffee-01
			var startTime = null;

			function draw(ts) {
				if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
				var t = (ts - startTime) / 1000;
				var W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
				var s = CONFIG.spacing * dpr;
				var r = CONFIG.dotR * dpr;
				ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
				var lights = CONFIG.lights.map(function (l) {
					return {
						x:  (l.cx + Math.sin(t * l.sx * Math.PI * 2) * l.rx) * W,
						y:  (l.cy + Math.cos(t * l.sy * Math.PI * 2) * l.ry) * H,
						r2: Math.pow(l.r * dpr, 2),
						b:  l.brightness,
					};
				});
				var arm   = r * 3;
				var thick = Math.max(1, dpr * 0.7);
				for (var x = s / 2; x < W; x += s) {
					for (var y = s / 2; y < H; y += s) {
						var glow = 0;
						for (var i = 0; i < lights.length; i++) {
							var l = lights[i], dx = x - l.x, dy = y - l.y;
							glow += l.b * Math.exp(-(dx * dx + dy * dy) / (l.r2 * 0.5));
						}
						var norm   = Math.min(glow, 1);
						var curved = Math.pow(norm, CONFIG.curve);
						var alpha  = CONFIG.baseA + curved * (CONFIG.peakA - CONFIG.baseA);
						ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + DOT_COLOR + ', ' + alpha.toFixed(3) + ')';
						ctx.fillRect(x - arm,         y - thick * 0.5, arm * 2, thick);
						ctx.fillRect(x - thick * 0.5, y - arm,         thick,   arm * 2);
					}
				}
				requestAnimationFrame(draw);
			}
			requestAnimationFrame(draw);
		})();

		/* ════ Phase 5 — Bento / Parallax / Centered CTA reveals ══════════ */
		(function () {
			var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
			var items  = root.querySelectorAll('.hm5-reveal');
			if (reduce || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
				items.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('hm5-is-visible'); });
				return;
			}
			var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
				entries.forEach(function (e) {
					if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('hm5-is-visible'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
				});
			}, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px', threshold: 0.12 });
			items.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
		})();

		/* ════ FAQ accordion ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
		(function () {
			var faqSection = root.querySelector('.faq-section');
			if (!faqSection) return;

			var faqItems = faqSection.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
			if (!faqItems.length) return;

			function closeItem(item) {
				item.classList.remove('open');
				var ans = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
				var btn = item.querySelector('.faq-btn');
				if (ans) ans.classList.remove('open');
				if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
			}
			function openItem(item) {
				item.classList.add('open');
				var ans = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
				var btn = item.querySelector('.faq-btn');
				if (ans) ans.classList.add('open');
				if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
			}

			faqItems.forEach(function (item) {
				var btn = item.querySelector('.faq-btn');
				if (!btn) return;
				btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
					var isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
					faqItems.forEach(closeItem);
					if (!isOpen) openItem(item);
				});
			});
		})();

	} /* end init() */

	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
	} else {
		init();
	}
})();
</script>

                // Lazy-load: replace data-src -> src when images enter viewport (or on first tick).
                (function lazyLoadBadges(){
                    const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]');
                    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
                    imgs.forEach(img => { if (img.dataset.src) img.src = img.dataset.src; });
                    return;
                    }
                    const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
                    for (const entry of entries) {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        const el = entry.target;
                        if (el.dataset.src) { el.src = el.dataset.src; el.removeAttribute('data-src'); }
                        io.unobserve(el);
                        }
                    }
                    }, { rootMargin: '200px' });
                    imgs.forEach(img => io.observe(img));
                })();

            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ######## Function to Set Cookie ######### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
                let d = new Date();
                d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                let expires = "expires="+d.toUTCString();
                document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
            }

            /* ***************************************** */
            /* #### Function to Set Cookie Minutes ###### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function setCookieMin(cname, cvalue, exminutes) {
                let d = new Date();
                d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exminutes * 60 * 1000)); // Convert minutes to milliseconds
                let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
                document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
            }

            /* #### Function to Set Cookie Root ###### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function setCookieRoot(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
                let d = new Date();
                d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();

                // Get the root domain
                let domain = window.location.hostname;
                if (domain.split('.').length > 2) {
                    domain = domain.split('.').slice(-2).join('.');
                }

                document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/;domain=." + domain;
            }
            
            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ######## Function to Get Cookie ######### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function getCookie(cname) {
                let name = cname + "=";
                let ca = document.cookie.split(';');
                for(let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
                    let c = ca[i];
                    while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                        c = c.substring(1);
                    }
                    if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                        return decodeURIComponent(c.substring(name.length, c.length));
                    }
                }
                return "";
            }

            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ###### Function to Wrap Meta Click ID ### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            /* Meta only parses a click ID in the _fbc shape: fb.<subdomainIndex>.<creationTime>.<fbclid>,
               where creationTime is Unix milliseconds (MA-711). The creation time is carried over when
               the cookie already holds the SAME click ID, so reloading a URL that still has ?fbclid= on
               it does not reset the clock. A different ID, a missing wrapper or a malformed one starts
               fresh. Parsed with indexOf rather than split() because a click ID may contain dots.
               Returns "" when the result would not fit Salesforce's Text(255) fbclid__c field: an
               over-long value fails the entire lead create with STRING_TOO_LONG, and a truncated click
               ID is unusable to Meta anyway, so the value is dropped rather than clipped. */
            function wrapFbclid(fbclid) {
                let previous = getCookie("utm_fbclid");
                let creationTime = Date.now();
                if (previous.indexOf("fb.") === 0) {
                    let timeStart = previous.indexOf(".", 3);
                    let idStart = timeStart > -1 ? previous.indexOf(".", timeStart + 1) : -1;
                    if (idStart > -1) {
                        let previousTime = previous.substring(timeStart + 1, idStart);
                        if (previous.substring(idStart + 1) === fbclid && /^\d+$/.test(previousTime)) {
                            creationTime = previousTime;
                        }
                    }
                }
                let wrapped = "fb.1." + creationTime + "." + fbclid;
                return wrapped.length > 255 ? "" : wrapped;
            }

            // Ensure window.__cbUserInfoData exists (fallback if PHP hydration didn't fire).
            if (!window.__cbUserInfoData) {
                window.__cbUserInfoData = {};
            }


            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ########## Does Cookie Exist ############ */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function doesCookieExist(cookieName) {
                let cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
                for(let i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
                    let cookie = cookies[i].trim();
                    // Check if the cookie name followed by '=' is at the start of the cookie string
                    if (cookie.startsWith(cookieName + '=')) {
                        return true; // The cookie exists
                    }
                }
                return false; // The cookie does not exist
            }

            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ########## EXTRACT EMAIL DOMAIN ######### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function extractEmailDomian(email) {
                var parts = email.toLowerCase().split("@");
                if (parts.length === 2) {
                    var domain = parts[1];
                    return domain;
                } else {
                    return null;
                }
            }


            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ############ CHECK FOR BLANK ############ */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function isBlank(value) {
                if (value === undefined || value === null) return true;
                if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length === 0) return true;
                if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0) return true;
                if (typeof value === 'object' && Object.keys(value).length === 0) return true;
                
                return false;
            }

            
            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ########### GET DOMAIN FROM URL ######### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function getAuthoritativeDomain(url) {
            try {
                if (!url || typeof url !== "string" || url.trim() === "") return "";

                const hasScheme = url.startsWith("http://") || url.startsWith("https://");
                const normalizedUrl = hasScheme ? url : "https://" + url;

                const parsedUrl = new URL(normalizedUrl);
                const hostname = parsedUrl.hostname;
                const parts = hostname.split('.');

                return parts.length > 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
            } catch (e) {
                return '';
            }
            }

            function filterEmail(email) {

                if(extractEmailDomian(email)=='byom.de')filter_result=1;

                    property_group_type: getValue(".form-property-group-type"),
                    job_role: getValue(".form-job-role"),

                    places_state: getValue(".places-state"),
                    places_country: getValue(".places-country"),

                // Merge generic fields: init if missing; update only with non-blank values
                Object.keys(fieldMap).forEach(key => {
                    if (!(key in existingData)) {

                    } else if (!isBlank(fieldMap[key])) {

            /**
             * Calculates a weighted total based on property type and relevant counts...
             * - Vacation Homes: listings / addresses
             * - Other types: rooms + (beds / 4)
             *
             * @param {object} formElement - The form (as a DOM or jQuery object) to be processed.
             */
            function calculateWeightedTotal(formElement) {
                var $form = $(formElement);
                var propertyType = $form.find('.form-property-type').val();
                var result = 0;

                if (propertyType === 'Vacation Homes') {
                    var listings = parseInt($form.find('.form-vr-listings-number').val(), 10) || 0;
                    var addresses = parseInt($form.find('.form-vr-address-number').val(), 10) || 0;

                    // Set room_count to listings for Vacation Homes
                    $form.find('.form-room-count').val(listings);                    

                    if (listings > 0 && addresses > 0) {
                        result = Math.round(listings / addresses);
                    } else {
                        // Fallback if VR fields incomplete
                        var rooms = parseInt($form.find('.form-room-count').val(), 10) || 0;
                        var beds = parseInt($form.find('.form-bed-count').val(), 10) || 0;
                        result = Math.round(rooms + (beds > 0 ? (beds / 4) : 0));
                    }
                } else {
                    // Hotel, Hostel, etc.
                    var rooms = parseInt($form.find('.form-room-count').val(), 10) || 0;
                    var beds = parseInt($form.find('.form-bed-count').val(), 10) || 0;
                    result = Math.round(rooms + (beds > 0 ? (beds / 4) : 0));
                }

                $form.find('.weighted-room-count').val(result);
                console.log("Calculated weighted room count: " + result);

                return result;
            }

        /* ---------- config ---------- */
            var MAX_WAIT_MS   = 4000;

            /* ---------- tiny helpers ---------- */
            function normalizeSb(o){
            o = o || {};
            return {
                utm_source:   o.utm_source   || o.src || '',
                utm_medium:   o.utm_medium   || o.mdm || '',
                utm_campaign: o.utm_campaign || o.cmp || '',
                utm_content:  o.utm_content  || o.cnt || '',
                utm_term:     o.utm_term     || o.trm || ''
            };
            }
            function utmsFromUrl(){
            var p = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
            return {
                utm_source:   p.get('utm_source')   || '',
                utm_medium:   p.get('utm_medium')   || '',
                utm_campaign: p.get('utm_campaign') || '',
                utm_content:  p.get('utm_content')  || '',
                utm_term:     p.get('utm_term')     || ''
            };
            }

            /* ---------- Pull true first landing from SBJS (first_add.ep) ---------- */
            function getFirstLandingFromSb() { 
            try {
                // Most recent SBJS exposes as a property object
                if (window.sbjs && sbjs.get && sbjs.get.first_add && sbjs.get.first_add.ep) {
                return sbjs.get.first_add.ep;
                }
                // Some builds expose first_add as a function returning {ep, rf, ...}
                if (window.sbjs && sbjs.get && typeof sbjs.get.first_add === 'function') {
                var fa = sbjs.get.first_add();
                if (fa && fa.ep) return fa.ep;
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            // Cookie fallback 
            try {
                var m = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie).match(/(?:^|; )sbjs_first_add=([^;]+)/);
                if (m) {
                var raw = decodeURIComponent(m[1]);
                var ep = raw.match(/(?:^|\|\|\|)ep=(.*?)(?:\|\|\|$|$)/);
                if (ep && ep[1]) return ep[1];
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            return '';
            }

            /* ---------- write to fields ---------- */
            function fillFields(info){
            var map = {
                'first-utm-medium'  : info.first_utm_medium,
                'first-utm-source'  : info.first_utm_source,
                'first-utm-campaign': info.first_utm_campaign,
                'first-utm-content' : info.first_utm_content,
                'first-utm-term'    : info.first_utm_term,
                'first-landing-page': info.first_landing_page,
                'first-refer-url'   : info.first_refer_url,
                'last-utm-medium'   : info.last_utm_medium,
                'last-utm-source'   : info.last_utm_source,
                'last-utm-campaign' : info.last_utm_campaign,
                'last-utm-content'  : info.last_utm_content,
                'last-utm-term'     : info.last_utm_term,
                'last-landing-page' : info.last_landing_page,
                'last-refer-url'    : info.last_refer_url,
                'sfcid-qs'          : info.sfcid_qs || ''
                // sfcid_url (MA-797) is deliberately NOT in this map. fillFields runs on every page
                // and writes '' when the URL has no value, which would blank a store-filled
                // .sfcid-url input. It is filled from the URL / store in the "MISCLL COOKIES" block.
            };

            // NEW: never overwrite first_* values if a value already exists
            var writeOnce = new Set([
                'first-utm-medium','first-utm-source','first-utm-campaign','first-utm-content',
                'first-utm-term','first-landing-page','first-refer-url'
            ]);

            for (var cls in map) {
                if (!map.hasOwnProperty(cls)) continue;
                var val = map[cls] || '';

                var nodes = document.querySelectorAll('.' + cls);
                for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
                if ('value' in nodes[i]) {
                    if (writeOnce.has(cls) && nodes[i].value) continue; // NEW
                    nodes[i].value = val;
                }
                }
                var inner = document.querySelectorAll('.' + cls + ' input');
                for (var j = 0; j < inner.length; j++) {
                if ('value' in inner[j]) {
                    if (writeOnce.has(cls) && inner[j].value) continue; // NEW
                    inner[j].value = val;
                }
                }
            }
            }

            /* ---------- core builders ---------- */
            function buildFromSbjs(){
            var firstRaw   = (sbjs && sbjs.get && sbjs.get.first)   || {};
            var currentRaw = (sbjs && sbjs.get && sbjs.get.current) || {};
            var general    = (sbjs && sbjs.get && sbjs.get.general) || {};

            var first   = normalizeSb(firstRaw);
            var current = normalizeSb(currentRaw);

            var urlP   = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
            var sfcid_qs  = urlP.get('sfcid') || '';

            return {
                /* first touch from SBJS */
                first_utm_medium:   first.utm_medium,
                first_utm_source:   first.utm_source,
                first_utm_campaign: first.utm_campaign,
                first_utm_content:  first.utm_content,
                first_utm_term:     first.utm_term,
                first_landing_page: getFirstLandingFromSb() || location.href,
                first_refer_url:    (general && general.referrer) || document.referrer || '',

                /* last/current from SBJS */
                last_utm_medium:   current.utm_medium,
                last_utm_source:   current.utm_source,
                last_utm_campaign: current.utm_campaign,
                last_utm_content:  current.utm_content,
                last_utm_term:     current.utm_term,
                last_landing_page: location.href,
                last_refer_url:    document.referrer || '',

                sfcid_qs: sfcid_qs
            };
            }

            function buildFromUrlFallback(){
            var u = utmsFromUrl();
            var urlP   = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
            var sfcid_qs  = urlP.get('sfcid') || '';

            return {
                /* treat URL as both first & last for this initial hit */
                first_utm_medium:   u.utm_medium,
                first_utm_source:   u.utm_source,
                first_utm_campaign: u.utm_campaign,
                first_utm_content:  u.utm_content,
                first_utm_term:     u.utm_term,
                first_landing_page: location.href,
                first_refer_url:    document.referrer || '',

                last_utm_medium:   u.utm_medium,
                last_utm_source:   u.utm_source,
                last_utm_campaign: u.utm_campaign,
                last_utm_content:  u.utm_content,
                last_utm_term:     u.utm_term,
                last_landing_page: location.href,
                last_refer_url:    document.referrer || '',

                sfcid_qs: sfcid_qs
            };
            }

            /* ---------- runner ---------- */
            (function start(){
            var deadline = Date.now() + MAX_WAIT_MS;

            function ready(){
                return !!(window.sbjs && sbjs.get && sbjs.get.first && sbjs.get.current);
            }
            function attempt(){
                if (ready()) { fillFields(buildFromSbjs()); return; }
                if (Date.now() >= deadline) { fillFields(buildFromUrlFallback()); return; }
                setTimeout(attempt, POLL_INTERVAL);
            }

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', attempt, { once: true });
                window.addEventListener('load', attempt);  /* late GTM/consent cases */
            } else {
                attempt();
                window.addEventListener('load', attempt);
            }
            })();

        </script>

            function prefillFormsFromCookie() {
                var cookieData = window.__cbUserInfoData;
                if (!cookieData || !Object.keys(cookieData).length) return;

                // Only pre-fill if the visitor has previously submitted a form
                if (!cookieData.form_filled) return;

                // Skip for customers — they use handleCustomerDemoBypass with fresh SF data
                if (window.userType && window.userType !== 'visitor') return;

                console.log('[cookie-prefill] form_filled=true, pre-filling forms');

                // Map cookie keys to form field selectors
                // Only populate VISIBLE user-input fields (contact + property info).
                // Hidden system fields (UTM, GeoIP, lead-source, etc.) are already
                // populated by their own dedicated logic and must NOT be overwritten.
                var fieldMap = {
                    full_name:             '.form-full-name',
                    first_name:            '.form-first-name',
                    last_name:             '.form-last-name',
                    email:                 '.form-email',
                    phone:                 '.form-phone',
                    property_name:         '.form-property-name',
                    property_type:         '.form-property-type',
                    room_count:            '.form-room-count',
                    bed_count:             '.form-bed-count',
                    job_role:              '.form-job-role',
                    property_group_type:   '.form-property-group-type',
                    vr_address_number:     '.form-vr-address-number',
                    vr_listings_number:    '.form-vr-listings-number',
                    multiple_properties:   '.form-multiple-properties'
                };

                // For each field: only set if the form field is currently empty
                // and the cookie has a non-blank value.
                // This ensures page-level defaults and any values the user has
                // already started typing are never overwritten.
                var populated = false;
                Object.keys(fieldMap).forEach(function(key) {
                    var value = cookieData[key];
                    if (!value || String(value).trim() === '') return;

                    var $fields = $(fieldMap[key]);
                    $fields.each(function() {
                        var $el = $(this);
                        if (!$el.val() || String($el.val()).trim() === '') {
                            $el.val(String(value).trim());
                            populated = true;
                        }
                    });
                });

                // Country dropdown: special handling (value is full country name).
                // [data-no-geo-select] selects opt out of ALL automatic country population,
                // not just the GeoIP pass (MA-654). Without this exclusion the Request a
                // Demo field is still preselected: a short-form submission GeoIP-picks a
                // country into a hidden select, that lands in the cookie, and this prefill
                // then restores it here -- defeating the point of asking the question.
                if (cookieData.country && String(cookieData.country).trim() !== '') {
                    $(".chili-countries select, select.chili-countries").not('[data-no-geo-select]').each(function() {
                        var $sel = $(this);
                        if (!$sel.val() || String($sel.val()).trim() === '') {
                            $sel.val(String(cookieData.country).trim());
                            populated = true;
                        }
                    });
                }

                // Short form: sync hidden .form-property-type value to visible dropdown
                if (cookieData.property_type && String(cookieData.property_type).trim() !== '') {
                    $(".short-form-property-type").each(function() {
                        var $sel = $(this);
                        if (!$sel.val() || String($sel.val()).trim() === '') {
                            $sel.val(String(cookieData.property_type).trim());
                            populated = true;
                        }
                    });
                }

                // Trigger change events only if we actually populated fields
                if (populated) {

                if (!langid && $chili.length && $chili.attr('type') !== 'hidden') {

                    langid = $chili.attr('langid') || $chili.val() || '1';
                    } else {
                    langid =
                        $chili.find(':selected').attr('langid') ||
                        $chili.find(':selected').val();
                    }
                }

                // Fallback: use the user-language <select>
                if (!langid || langid === '0') {
                    const $userLang = $form.find('select.user-language');
                    langid =
                    $userLang.find(':selected').attr('langid') ||

<script id="cbui-user-context-js-after">
(function () {
  var KEY             = 'cb.user.ctx.v1';
  var COOKIE          = 'cb_user_ctx';
  var COOKIE_TTL_MIN  = 30;
  var ALLOW_CROSS_TAB = true;
  var SESSION_KEY     = 'cb.user.info.session.created';
  var DEBUG_MODE      = false;
  var INIT_FIRED_KEY  = 'cb.user.init.fired.v2';
  var CACHE_TS_KEY    = 'cb.user.ctx.ts';
  var REVALIDATE_MIN_SEC = 15;

  // --- Query param helper (for ?showcookie) ---
  function hasQueryParam(name) {
    try {
      var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      return params.has(name);
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  var SHOW_COOKIE_DEBUG = hasQueryParam('showcookie');
  if (SHOW_COOKIE_DEBUG) {
    console.log('Start the check marketing cookie now');
  }

  if (DEBUG_MODE) {
    try {
      sessionStorage.removeItem(KEY);
      sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
      sessionStorage.removeItem(INIT_FIRED_KEY);
      sessionStorage.removeItem(CACHE_TS_KEY);
      console.log('Debug mode: Cleared session cache for cb_user_info testing');
    } catch(e) {
      console.log('Debug mode: Could not clear session storage', e);
    }
  }

  function setCookie(name, value, ttlMinutes) {
    if (!ALLOW_CROSS_TAB) return;
    try {
      var d = new Date();
      d.setTime(d.getTime() + ttlMinutes * 60 * 1000);
      document.cookie = name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) +
        ";path=/;SameSite=Lax;Secure;expires=" + d.toUTCString();
    } catch(e){}
  }
  
  function setCookieDays(name, value, days) {
    try {
      var d = new Date();
      d.setTime(d.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
      document.cookie = name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) +
        ";path=/;SameSite=Lax;Secure;expires=" + d.toUTCString();
    } catch(e){}
  }
  
  function getCookie(name) {
    var m = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|; )' + name + '=([^;]*)'));
    return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
  }

  // --- Language + country helpers ---
  function getSiteLanguage() {
    var langAttr = (document.documentElement.lang || '').toLowerCase();
    if (langAttr.length >= 2) return langAttr.substring(0, 2);
    return 'en';
  }

function getUserCountry() {
  try {
    // <select name="country" class="chili-countries ...">
    var select = document.querySelector('select.chili-countries');
    if (!select) return null;

    // What the browser / Chili is currently showing, e.g. "United States"
    var visible = (select.value || '').trim();
    if (!visible) return null;

    // Find the <option> whose text OR value matches what we see
    var options = Array.from(select.options || []);
    var opt = options.find(function (o) {
      var text  = (o.text  || '').trim();
      var value = (o.value || '').trim();
      return text === visible || value === visible;
    });

    if (!opt) return null;

    // Return the ISO-ish code from the attribute, e.g. "US"
    return opt.getAttribute('ccode') || null;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}


  // --- Init event guard: two-phase lock ---
  // 'pending'   = init pushed but GTM hasn't consumed it yet (re-fire on next page)
  // 'confirmed' = GTM processed the init event (done for this session)
  function initEventAlreadyFired() {
    if (window.__cbInitEventFired === true) return true;
    try {
      return sessionStorage.getItem(INIT_FIRED_KEY) === 'confirmed';
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function markInitEventFired() {
    window.__cbInitEventFired = true;
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(INIT_FIRED_KEY, 'pending');
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function primeWindow(obj) {
    obj = obj || {};
    window.userType    = obj.userType || 'visitor';
    window.userContext = obj;
    
    if (obj.marketingData) {
      window.firstNameMC = obj.marketingData.first_name  || '';
      window.lastNameMC  = obj.marketingData.last_name   || '';
      window.emailMC     = obj.marketingData.email       || '';
      window.propidMC    = obj.marketingData.property_id || '';
    } else {
      window.firstNameMC = '';
      window.lastNameMC  = '';
      window.emailMC     = '';
      window.propidMC    = '';
    }
    
    window.useremailMC = obj.useremailMC || null;
    
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'user_context_ready', userType: window.userType });
    
    if (DEBUG_MODE) {
      console.log('Debug: Window variables set:', {
        userType: window.userType,
        firstNameMC: window.firstNameMC,
        lastNameMC: window.lastNameMC,
        emailMC: window.emailMC,
        propidMC: window.propidMC,
        useremailMC: window.useremailMC
      });
    }

    // Fire the init event only once per session
    pushInitEventFromContextOnce(obj);
  }

  // --- Simple init event based on customer / non-customer ---
  function pushInitEventFromContextOnce(ctx) {
    if (initEventAlreadyFired()) {
      if (DEBUG_MODE || SHOW_COOKIE_DEBUG) {
        console.log('Init event already confirmed by GTM this session, skipping');
      }
      return;
    }
    if (DEBUG_MODE || SHOW_COOKIE_DEBUG) {
      try {
        var prev = sessionStorage.getItem(INIT_FIRED_KEY);
        if (prev === 'pending') {
          console.log('Init event was pending (GTM did not consume it last page), re-firing');
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    }
    pushInitEventFromContext(ctx);
    markInitEventFired();
  }

  function pushInitEventFromContext(ctx) {
    ctx = ctx || {};

    var marketing  = ctx.marketingData || {};
    var propertyId = marketing.property_id || window.propidMC || '';
    var loggedIn   = propertyId ? 'true' : 'false';

    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

    var payload = {
      event: 'init',
      site_language: getSiteLanguage(),
      logged_in: loggedIn,
      userData: {
        propid: propertyId || '',
        user_country: getUserCountry() || null
      }
    };

    window.dataLayer.push(payload);

    // Push a GTM callback function — GTM executes these when it processes
    // the dataLayer queue. When this runs, we know GTM received the init event
    // and can lock the session so it won't re-fire on subsequent pages.
    window.dataLayer.push(function() {
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem(INIT_FIRED_KEY, 'confirmed');
      } catch(e) {}
    });

    if (SHOW_COOKIE_DEBUG || DEBUG_MODE) {
      console.log('Init event pushed:', payload);
    }
  }

  function createUserInfoFromMarketing(marketingData) {
    if (DEBUG_MODE) {
      console.log('Debug: createUserInfoFromMarketing called with:', marketingData);
    }
    
    // Check server-hydrated data.
    var parsed = null;
    if (window.__cbUserInfoData && Object.keys(window.__cbUserInfoData).length) {
      parsed = window.__cbUserInfoData;
    }
    var shouldCreate = false;

    if (!parsed) {
      shouldCreate = true;
      if (DEBUG_MODE) console.log('Debug: No existing user info data found');
    } else {
      if (!parsed.form_filled || parsed.form_filled !== true) {
        shouldCreate = true;
        if (DEBUG_MODE) console.log('Debug: Existing data has form_filled:', parsed.form_filled);
      } else {
        if (DEBUG_MODE) console.log('Debug: Existing data has form_filled=true, not recreating');
      }
    }
    
    if (!DEBUG_MODE) {
      try {
        if (sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY) === 'true') {
          shouldCreate = false;
          console.log('Debug: Already created in this session');
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    }
    
    if (DEBUG_MODE) {
      console.log('Debug: shouldCreate =', shouldCreate);
      console.log('Debug: marketingData exists =', !!marketingData);
    }
    
    if (shouldCreate && marketingData) {
      if (!marketingData.first_name &&
          !marketingData.last_name &&
          !marketingData.email &&
          !marketingData.property_id) {
        if (DEBUG_MODE) console.log('Debug: Marketing data is empty, not creating cookie');
        return;
      }
      
      var cbuserinfo = {
        first_name: marketingData.first_name  || '',
        last_name:  marketingData.last_name   || '',
        email:      marketingData.email       || '',
        phone: '',
        country: '',
        property_name: '',
        property_type: '',
        room_count: '',
        bed_count: '',
        geo_postal_code: '',
        property_group_type: '',
        job_role: '',
        sfcid_form: '',
        sfcid_qs: '',
        sfcid_url: '',
        product_name: '',
        last_lead_source: '',
        vr_address_number: '',
        vr_Listings_Number: '',
        property_id: marketingData.property_id || '',
        form_filled: false
      };
      
      // Persist to server-side encrypted store + update in-memory hydration.
      window.__cbUserInfoData = cbuserinfo;
      fetch('/wp-json/cloudbeds/v1/user-info', {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify(cbuserinfo)
      }).catch(function(e) { console.error('[cb_user_info] Store seed failed:', e); });

      if (!DEBUG_MODE) {
        try {
          sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, 'true');
        } catch(e) {}
      }

      console.log('User info store seeded from marketing data:', cbuserinfo);
    }
  }

  // --- Use cached data immediately (stale-while-revalidate pattern) ---
  var usedCache = false;
  
  if (!DEBUG_MODE) {
    // Try to use cached sessionStorage data first (for fast page load)
    try {
      var s = sessionStorage.getItem(KEY);
      if (s) {
        var cachedData = JSON.parse(s);
        primeWindow(cachedData);
        if (cachedData.marketingData) {
          createUserInfoFromMarketing(cachedData.marketingData);
        }
        usedCache = true;
        
        if (SHOW_COOKIE_DEBUG) {
          console.log('Using cached data, fetching fresh data in background...');
        }
        // Don't return - continue to fetch in background
      }
    } catch(e){}

    // Try cached cookie data if sessionStorage failed
    if (!usedCache) {
      var c = getCookie(COOKIE);
      if (c) {
        try {
          var obj = JSON.parse(c);
          primeWindow(obj);
          try { sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, c); } catch(e){}
          if (obj.marketingData) {
            createUserInfoFromMarketing(obj.marketingData);
          }
          usedCache = true;
          
          if (SHOW_COOKIE_DEBUG) {
            console.log('Using cached cookie data, fetching fresh data in background...');
          }
          // Don't return - continue to fetch in background
        } catch(e){}
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Always fetch fresh data in background (or foreground if no cache) ---
  // Guard against duplicate fetches if script is loaded multiple times
  if (window.__cbUserFetchInProgress) {
    if (DEBUG_MODE || SHOW_COOKIE_DEBUG) {
      console.log('Fetch already in progress, skipping duplicate call');
    }
    return;
  }

  // Throttle: skip background revalidation if cache is fresh (< REVALIDATE_MIN_SEC old)
  if (usedCache && !DEBUG_MODE) {
    try {
      var cachedAt = parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem(CACHE_TS_KEY) || '0', 10);
      var age = (Date.now() - cachedAt) / 1000;
      if (age < REVALIDATE_MIN_SEC) {
        if (SHOW_COOKIE_DEBUG) {
          console.log('Cache is ' + Math.round(age) + 's old (< ' + REVALIDATE_MIN_SEC + 's), skipping background fetch');
        }
        return;
      }
    } catch(e) {}
  }

  if (DEBUG_MODE || !usedCache) {
    if (DEBUG_MODE) {
      console.log('Debug: Fetching from /wp-json/cloudbeds/v1/customer-info');
    }
  }

  // Mark fetch as in progress
  window.__cbUserFetchInProgress = true;

  fetch('/wp-json/cloudbeds/v1/customer-info', { 
    method: 'GET',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    headers: {
      'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
    }
  })
    .then(function(r){ 
      if (DEBUG_MODE) {
        console.log('Debug: REST response status:', r.status);
      }
      if (r.status === 429) {
        throw new Error('Rate limit exceeded');
      }
      return r.json(); 
    })
    .then(function(obj){
      if (DEBUG_MODE) {
        console.log('Debug: REST response data:', obj);
      }
      
      primeWindow(obj);
      
      if (obj.marketingData) {
        createUserInfoFromMarketing(obj.marketingData);
      } else if (DEBUG_MODE) {
        console.log('Debug: No marketingData in REST response');
      }
      
      if (!DEBUG_MODE) {
        try { sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(obj)); } catch(e){}
        try { sessionStorage.setItem(CACHE_TS_KEY, String(Date.now())); } catch(e){}
        try { setCookie(COOKIE, JSON.stringify(obj), COOKIE_TTL_MIN); } catch(e){}
      }
      
      // Clear fetch flag to allow future fetches
      window.__cbUserFetchInProgress = false;
    })
    .catch(function(error){
      if (DEBUG_MODE) {
        console.error('Debug: Error fetching customer info:', error);
      }
      // Don't override cached data on error - it's already being used
      // This prevents downgrading to visitor on rate limit or network errors
      if (!usedCache) {
        // Only set fallback if we had no cache to begin with
        primeWindow({ userType: 'visitor' });
      }
      
      // Clear fetch flag to allow future fetches
      window.__cbUserFetchInProgress = false;
    });
})();

/* Helper: compute SHA-256 and cache on window._cbEmailSha256 */
window._cbComputeEmailHash = function(email) {
  if (!email || !window.crypto || !window.crypto.subtle) return;
  var normalized = email.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (window._cbEmailSha256 && window._cbEmailSha256.src === normalized) return;
  var enc = new TextEncoder();
  window.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', enc.encode(normalized))
    .then(function(buf) {
      window._cbEmailSha256 = {
        src: normalized,
        hash: Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf))
          .map(function(b) { return b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'); }).join('')
      };
    });
};

/* Eagerly pre-compute hash from known email sources at page load */
(function() {
  var knownEmail = (window.__cbUserInfoData && window.__cbUserInfoData.email)
    || window.emailMC || '';
  if (knownEmail) window._cbComputeEmailHash(knownEmail);
})();

window.cbResolveUserData = function(formSelector) {
  var fd = (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined' && formSelector) ? jQuery(formSelector) : null;
  var cbd = window.__cbUserInfoData || {};

  var email = (fd && fd.find('.form-email').val())
    || cbd.email
    || window.emailMC
    || '';
  var phone = (fd && fd.find('.form-phone').val())
    || cbd.phone
    || '';
  var firstName = (fd && fd.find('.form-first-name').val())
    || cbd.first_name
    || window.firstNameMC
    || '';
  var lastName = (fd && fd.find('.form-last-name').val())
    || cbd.last_name
    || window.lastNameMC
    || '';
  var country = (fd && fd.find('.chili-countries').find(':selected').attr('ccode'))
    || cbd.country
    || '';

  /* Resolve SHA-256 hash: identity plugin global → pre-computed cache → trigger async for next call */
  var emailHash = window.useremailMC || '';
  if (!emailHash && email) {
    var normalized = email.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (window._cbEmailSha256 && window._cbEmailSha256.src === normalized) {
      emailHash = window._cbEmailSha256.hash;
    } else {
      window._cbComputeEmailHash(email);
    }
  }

  return {
    user_email: email,
    user_email_sha256: emailHash,
    user_phone: phone,
    user_firstname: firstName,
    user_lastname: lastName,
    user_country: country,
    propid: (typeof window.propidMC !== 'undefined' && window.propidMC) ? window.propidMC : ''

};

      <script>
      (function () {
        const DROPDOWN = ".langDropdown";
        const BTN = ".langBtn";
        const WRAPPER = ".langMenuWrapper";
        const MENU = ".langMenu";

        function open(wrapper, btn) {
          wrapper.classList.remove("hidden", "opacity-0", "translate-y-1");
          btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
        }

        function close(wrapper, btn) {
          wrapper.classList.add("hidden", "opacity-0", "translate-y-1");
          btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        }

        // Init all language dropdowns.
        // Deferred to DOMContentLoaded: this script is parsed before the mobile
        // header (included later in header.php), so at inline-execution time the
        // mobile .langDropdown doesn't exist yet. Running on DOMContentLoaded lets
        // this single init cover BOTH the desktop and mobile switchers — the mobile
        // one has no hover on touch, so it needs the JS click toggle to open.
        function initLangDropdowns() {
        document.querySelectorAll(DROPDOWN).forEach((root) => {
          const btn = root.querySelector(BTN);
          const wrapper = root.querySelector(WRAPPER);
          const menu = root.querySelector(MENU);
          if (!btn || !wrapper || !menu) return;
          if (btn.dataset.langInit === "1") return; // guard against double-binding
          btn.dataset.langInit = "1";

          // Toggle via button (no navigation here)
          btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault(); // keep button from submitting anything
            const isHidden = wrapper.classList.contains("hidden");
            if (isHidden) open(wrapper, btn);
            else close(wrapper, btn);
          });

          // IMPORTANT: Do NOT intercept clicks inside the menu.
          // Let anchor tags behave normally (navigate).
          // So: no click handler on `menu`.

          // Click outside -> close
          document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            if (!root.contains(e.target)) close(wrapper, btn);
          });

          // Escape key -> close
          document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
            if (e.key === "Escape") {
              close(wrapper, btn);
              btn.focus();
            }
          });
        });
        }

        if (document.readyState === "loading") {
          document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initLangDropdowns);
        } else {
          initLangDropdowns();
        }
      })();
      </script>

<script>
  // ---------- Desktop mega menu (desktop) ----------
  (function() {
    const triggers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-panel]');
    const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.js-panel');
    const backdrop = document.querySelector('.js-backdrop');
    const header = document.querySelector('header');
    const primaryNavItems = document.querySelectorAll('#desktop-nav nav > a, #desktop-nav nav > button'); // All primary nav items

    function openPanel(id, trigger) {
      panels.forEach(p => {
        const active = p.id === id;
        p.classList.toggle('opacity-100', active);
        p.classList.toggle('pointer-events-auto', active);
        p.classList.toggle('opacity-0', !active);
        p.classList.toggle('pointer-events-none', !active);
      });
      triggers.forEach(t => t.setAttribute('aria-expanded', t === trigger ? 'true' : 'false'));
      backdrop.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeAll() {
      panels.forEach(p => {
        p.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
        p.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'pointer-events-auto');
      });
      triggers.forEach(t => t.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      backdrop.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // Handle dropdown triggers (buttons with data-panel)
    triggers.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => openPanel(btn.dataset.panel, btn));
      btn.addEventListener('focus', () => openPanel(btn.dataset.panel, btn));
      // Optional click toggle for accessibility
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const expanded = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
        expanded ? closeAll() : openPanel(btn.dataset.panel, btn);
      });
    });

    // Handle regular links - close panels when hovering over them
    primaryNavItems.forEach(item => {
      // Only add close behavior to items that are NOT dropdown triggers
      if (!item.hasAttribute('data-panel')) {
        item.addEventListener('mouseenter', closeAll);
      }
    });

    header.addEventListener('mouseleave', closeAll);
    backdrop?.addEventListener('click', closeAll);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') closeAll();
    });
  })();

  // ---------- Mobile drawer ----------
  (function() {
    const openBtn = document.getElementById('mobile-open');
    const drawer = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer');
    if (!openBtn || !drawer) return;

    function openDrawer() {
      drawer.classList.remove('hidden');
      document.documentElement.classList.add('overflow-hidden');

      // Force-close any expanded sections so everything starts collapsed
      drawer.querySelectorAll('details[open]').forEach(d => d.removeAttribute('open'));
    }

    function closeDrawer() {
      drawer.classList.add('hidden');
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('overflow-hidden');
    }

    openBtn.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
    drawer.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer));
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && !drawer.classList.contains('hidden')) closeDrawer();
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
    // Wait for the window to load before starting the animation
    window.onload = function() {
        const canvas = document.getElementById('zoom-canvas');
        if (!canvas) {
            console.error("404 Animation: Canvas not found.");
            return;
        }
        
        // Get the .animation-container parent element
        const wrapper = canvas.parentElement; 
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // Set canvas size based on its container, not the window
        let width = canvas.width = wrapper.clientWidth;
        let height = canvas.height = wrapper.clientHeight;

        // Animation parameters
        const numSegments = 30; 
        const segmentLength = 30; 
        let tunnelWidth = width / 2.5;  // Base width of the tunnel
        let tunnelHeight = height / 2.5; // Base height of the tunnel
        const focalLength = 50; 
        const zoomSpeed = 0.4; 

        // --- NEW ---
        // Calculate the maximum Z depth
        const maxZ = numSegments * segmentLength;
        // --- END NEW ---

        // Array to hold the z-position of each tunnel segment
        let segments = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < numSegments; i++) {
            segments.push({ z: i * segmentLength });
        }

        // Handle window resizing
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            // Recalculate size based on the container
            width = canvas.width = wrapper.clientWidth;
            height = canvas.height = wrapper.clientHeight;
            
            // Recalculate tunnel dimensions on resize
            tunnelWidth = width / 2.5;
            tunnelHeight = height / 2.5;
        });

        // The main animation loop
        function animate() {
            // Clear the canvas
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f8f8f8';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

            // Set line style for the grid
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#e0e0e0';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;

            const centerX = width / 2;
            const centerY = height / 2;

            // Sort segments
            segments.sort((a, b) => b.z - a.z);

            // Draw the converging perspective lines
            const farZ = segments[0].z; // Get the farthest z
            const farScale = focalLength / (focalLength + farZ);
            const farX = tunnelWidth * farScale;
            const farY = tunnelHeight * farScale;

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(centerX - farX, centerY - farY);
            ctx.lineTo(0, 0);
            ctx.moveTo(centerX + farX, centerY - farY);
            ctx.lineTo(width, 0);
            ctx.moveTo(centerX + farX, centerY + farY);
            ctx.lineTo(width, height);
            ctx.moveTo(centerX - farX, centerY + farY);
            ctx.lineTo(0, height);
            ctx.stroke();

            // Update and draw each segment
            for (const segment of segments) {
                // Update Z position
                segment.z -= zoomSpeed;

                // If segment is behind the "camera", reset it to the back
                if (segment.z <= 0) {
                    segment.z = numSegments * segmentLength;
                }

                // 3D to 2D projection
                const scale = focalLength / (focalLength + segment.z);
                const x = tunnelWidth * scale;
                const y = tunnelHeight * scale;

                // --- NEW ---
                // Calculate opacity: 1.0 (closest) to 0.2 (farthest)
                const closenessPercent = 1 - (segment.z / maxZ);
                const opacity = 0.2 + (closenessPercent * 0.6);
                
                // Set the opacity for this segment
                ctx.globalAlpha = opacity;
                // --- END NEW ---

                // Draw the rectangle
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.rect(centerX - x, centerY - y, x * 2, y * 2);
                ctx.stroke();

                // --- NEW ---
                // Reset globalAlpha to 1.0 for the next frame's
                // converging lines and background clear
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
                // --- END NEW ---
            }

            // Request the next animation frame
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        // Start the animation
        animate();
    };
</script>

            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ######## Function to Set Cookie ######### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
                let d = new Date();
                d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                let expires = "expires="+d.toUTCString();
                document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
            }

            /* ***************************************** */
            /* #### Function to Set Cookie Minutes ###### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function setCookieMin(cname, cvalue, exminutes) {
                let d = new Date();
                d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exminutes * 60 * 1000)); // Convert minutes to milliseconds
                let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
                document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
            }

            /* #### Function to Set Cookie Root ###### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function setCookieRoot(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
                let d = new Date();
                d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();

                // Get the root domain
                let domain = window.location.hostname;
                if (domain.split('.').length > 2) {
                    domain = domain.split('.').slice(-2).join('.');
                }

                document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/;domain=." + domain;
            }
            
            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ######## Function to Get Cookie ######### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function getCookie(cname) {
                let name = cname + "=";
                let ca = document.cookie.split(';');
                for(let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
                    let c = ca[i];
                    while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                        c = c.substring(1);
                    }
                    if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                        return decodeURIComponent(c.substring(name.length, c.length));
                    }
                }
                return "";
            }

            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ###### Function to Wrap Meta Click ID ### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            /* Meta only parses a click ID in the _fbc shape: fb.<subdomainIndex>.<creationTime>.<fbclid>,
               where creationTime is Unix milliseconds (MA-711). The creation time is carried over when
               the cookie already holds the SAME click ID, so reloading a URL that still has ?fbclid= on
               it does not reset the clock. A different ID, a missing wrapper or a malformed one starts
               fresh. Parsed with indexOf rather than split() because a click ID may contain dots.
               Returns "" when the result would not fit Salesforce's Text(255) fbclid__c field: an
               over-long value fails the entire lead create with STRING_TOO_LONG, and a truncated click
               ID is unusable to Meta anyway, so the value is dropped rather than clipped. */
            function wrapFbclid(fbclid) {
                let previous = getCookie("utm_fbclid");
                let creationTime = Date.now();
                if (previous.indexOf("fb.") === 0) {
                    let timeStart = previous.indexOf(".", 3);
                    let idStart = timeStart > -1 ? previous.indexOf(".", timeStart + 1) : -1;
                    if (idStart > -1) {
                        let previousTime = previous.substring(timeStart + 1, idStart);
                        if (previous.substring(idStart + 1) === fbclid && /^\d+$/.test(previousTime)) {
                            creationTime = previousTime;
                        }
                    }
                }
                let wrapped = "fb.1." + creationTime + "." + fbclid;
                return wrapped.length > 255 ? "" : wrapped;
            }

            // Ensure window.__cbUserInfoData exists (fallback if PHP hydration didn't fire).
            if (!window.__cbUserInfoData) {
                window.__cbUserInfoData = {};
            }


            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ########## Does Cookie Exist ############ */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function doesCookieExist(cookieName) {
                let cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
                for(let i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
                    let cookie = cookies[i].trim();
                    // Check if the cookie name followed by '=' is at the start of the cookie string
                    if (cookie.startsWith(cookieName + '=')) {
                        return true; // The cookie exists
                    }
                }
                return false; // The cookie does not exist
            }

            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ########## EXTRACT EMAIL DOMAIN ######### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function extractEmailDomian(email) {
                var parts = email.toLowerCase().split("@");
                if (parts.length === 2) {
                    var domain = parts[1];
                    return domain;
                } else {
                    return null;
                }
            }


            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ############ CHECK FOR BLANK ############ */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function isBlank(value) {
                if (value === undefined || value === null) return true;
                if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length === 0) return true;
                if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0) return true;
                if (typeof value === 'object' && Object.keys(value).length === 0) return true;
                
                return false;
            }

            
            /* ***************************************** */
            /* ########### GET DOMAIN FROM URL ######### */
            /* ***************************************** */

            function getAuthoritativeDomain(url) {
            try {
                if (!url || typeof url !== "string" || url.trim() === "") return "";

                const hasScheme = url.startsWith("http://") || url.startsWith("https://");
                const normalizedUrl = hasScheme ? url : "https://" + url;

                const parsedUrl = new URL(normalizedUrl);
                const hostname = parsedUrl.hostname;
                const parts = hostname.split('.');

                return parts.length > 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
            } catch (e) {
                return '';
            }
            }

            function filterEmail(email) {

                if(extractEmailDomian(email)=='byom.de')filter_result=1;

                    property_group_type: getValue(".form-property-group-type"),
                    job_role: getValue(".form-job-role"),

                    places_state: getValue(".places-state"),
                    places_country: getValue(".places-country"),

                // Merge generic fields: init if missing; update only with non-blank values
                Object.keys(fieldMap).forEach(key => {
                    if (!(key in existingData)) {

                    } else if (!isBlank(fieldMap[key])) {

            /**
             * Calculates a weighted total based on property type and relevant counts...
             * - Vacation Homes: listings / addresses
             * - Other types: rooms + (beds / 4)
             *
             * @param {object} formElement - The form (as a DOM or jQuery object) to be processed.
             */
            function calculateWeightedTotal(formElement) {
                var $form = $(formElement);
                var propertyType = $form.find('.form-property-type').val();
                var result = 0;

                if (propertyType === 'Vacation Homes') {
                    var listings = parseInt($form.find('.form-vr-listings-number').val(), 10) || 0;
                    var addresses = parseInt($form.find('.form-vr-address-number').val(), 10) || 0;

                    // Set room_count to listings for Vacation Homes
                    $form.find('.form-room-count').val(listings);                    

                    if (listings > 0 && addresses > 0) {
                        result = Math.round(listings / addresses);
                    } else {
                        // Fallback if VR fields incomplete
                        var rooms = parseInt($form.find('.form-room-count').val(), 10) || 0;
                        var beds = parseInt($form.find('.form-bed-count').val(), 10) || 0;
                        result = Math.round(rooms + (beds > 0 ? (beds / 4) : 0));
                    }
                } else {
                    // Hotel, Hostel, etc.
                    var rooms = parseInt($form.find('.form-room-count').val(), 10) || 0;
                    var beds = parseInt($form.find('.form-bed-count').val(), 10) || 0;
                    result = Math.round(rooms + (beds > 0 ? (beds / 4) : 0));
                }

                $form.find('.weighted-room-count').val(result);
                console.log("Calculated weighted room count: " + result);

                return result;
            }

        /* ---------- config ---------- */
            var MAX_WAIT_MS   = 4000;
